caption:
This morning I covered Anthropic's new reporting tools that show what a team's token spend produced, what it cost and where workflows broke down.

I went back in for three more data points. 900% net revenue retention for Anthropic, per TechCrunch. Anthropic's share of token spend in Ramp's index rose from 51.3% to 60.5%. Pooled team budgets alert admins at 4 levels, from 50% to 100%.

My take: rising spend proves usage, not value. Measure output per dollar before you scale.

Comment ADOPTION and I will send you the details by DM.

scenes: This morning: Anthropic's new tools show what token spend actually delivers. I went back in and checked what other sources are measuring.
First, Anthropic told investors that the same customers now spend nine times more than a year ago. That is 900% net revenue retention, per TechCrunch.
Second, among businesses in Ramp's AI Index, Anthropic's share of token spending rose from 51.3% to 60.5% in four weeks.
Third, pooled team budgets send alerts at four points: 50%, 75%, 95% and 100% of the shared monthly limit.
My take: rising spend proves people use it, not that it paid off. Measure output per dollar on one workflow before you scale.
